about: T-527 (built 2026-11-07, the user: "A outdoors, B indoors"): one battle per terrain the maps reach, each a wild level-5 foe through DEBUG -> ENCOUNTER on a tile of that terrain (the terrain is read off the tile the player stands on, battle_setup.c), INVOKE ending its own stop (the DEBUG step closes with B, which a battle swallows) and the battle the next: the backdrop and the platforms under the daemons. The entry strips slide in while that B is pressed, so they are decoded from the ROM with the two terrains no map reaches; PLAIN (the building drawing in PLAIN's palette) on Route 1's path; PEWTER's BENCHMARK room through its trainer; and the grass again at night. LONG GRASS (no map uses its tile) and UNDERWATER (no map reaches it) are decoded from the ROM instead. The theatre's debug scratch save; nothing is saved.
